purpose: Define one deterministic machine-readable conformance result for Contract Format 1.4 validation so a consumer can distinguish structural validity, semantic completeness, reference closure, traceability, gap state, evidence sufficiency and lock eligibility without reducing them to one opaque pass/fail flag.

overall_rule.conformant: Every applicable required dimension passes and no hard_fail/error condition invalidates the target semantic surface.
overall_rule.non_conformant: At least one applicable required dimension fails.
overall_rule.incomplete_validation: A required validation dimension could not be evaluated deterministically.

value.lock_rule: Conformant does not automatically mean locked. Lock eligibility is a separate explicit result and requires all lock gates and evidence requirements to pass.
value.no_boolean_collapse_rule: A single boolean may be exposed as convenience output, but it must not replace the structured conformance result.
value.repository_rule: Repository-wide conformance is recursively aggregated from the active graph; inactive historical material is reported separately and does not silently fail active conformance unless an active reference depends on it.

value.purpose: Group complete Contract Format 1.4 validation outcome semantics.

invariants.rule: Every non-pass conformance state identifies the affected dimension, finding and evidence/gap refs.
Structural or semantic validity alone does not imply locked status.

hard_gates.condition: Conformance is represented only as an opaque boolean without dimension-level evidence.
Overall conformance is declared while an applicable required validation dimension was not evaluated.
A target becomes locked solely because overall conformance is pass without separate lock eligibility validation.
A failure cannot identify its validation dimension and supporting evidence or gap.

references.purpose: Unresolved gaps participate explicitly in conformance.
Lock eligibility remains distinct from conformance.

prose.summary: Defines one explainable machine-readable result for complete Contract Format 1.4 validation instead of collapsing canonical validity into a single pass/fail bit.
notes: Unlocked until the complete 1.4 validation pipeline and repository-wide report are exercised against the assembled review tree.
Pass 8 formalized previously free Flow actor/data/target/condition/payload/result/error tokens as exact owner-scoped member identities while preserving every source literal.

semantics.identity_rule: This member gives an exact owner-scoped identity to the literal Flow token without adding semantics beyond the owning Flow reference field and the preserved source literal.
semantics.interpretation_rule: Consumers may use this identity as an opaque declared Flow symbol. No meaning may be inferred from spelling, whitespace, filename, path or similarity to another symbol.
semantics.authority_rule: A Flow symbol is descriptive/causal model data only and never grants runtime authority, capability, ownership or execution permission.
semantics.scope_rule: Identity is scoped semantically to the defining contract; identical source literals in another contract or another Flow-ref role are not automatically the same semantic identity.
